description: This file provides PHP API functions for accessing and manipulating data model parameters related to CCSP, including retrieving and setting parameter values, managing object instances, and deleting objects.

methods.name: DmGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieves multiple parameter values for a given root object.

methods.name: DmSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Sets multiple parameter values for a given root object.

methods.name: DmGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs under a specified object table.

methods.name: DmAddObj
methods.description: Adds a new object instance under a specified object table.
